title: 3D Imaging of Defects, Buried Interfaces, and Strain with Multislice Electron Ptychography
content: As devices continue to shrink, precise control over atomic-scale structures – such as dopant placement, interface roughness, and other critical structural features – becomes increasingly critical for optimizing performance in both classical and quantum computing applications. Achieving reliable, dose-efficient 3D visualization of atomic-scale structures and defects is therefore essential. In this talk I will show how Multislice Electron Ptychography (MEP) meets this challenge, enabling 3D imaging with deep sub-Ångstrom lateral resolution and nanometer-scale depth resolution, providing new insights into Gate-All-Around (GAA) transistor structures and rare-earth dopant behaviors in silicon carbide (SiC) [1,2].
